'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*Aftermath of the [[October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état]]
**Soldiers open fire on civilians in [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]], protesting against last month's [[coup d'état]], killing 14 people and injuring dozens more. This brings the total death toll of civilians killed during the protests to 38. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/17/sudan-authorities-close-bridges-ahead-of-mass-anti-coup-protests (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**The death toll from the attack at a [[Military base|military post]] in Inata, [[Soum Province]], [[Burkina Faso]], three days ago, increases to 53, including 49 [[Gendarmerie|gendarmes]] and four civilians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/17/burkina-faso-death-toll-security-post-attack-jumps-to-53 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis]]; [[Estonia–Russia barrier]]
**[[Estonia]] summons 1,700 [[reservist]]s for a snap [[military exercise|drill]], which will include installing a 40-kilometer-long [[Barbed tape|razor wire]] barrier along the border with [[Russia]] as the migrant crisis with [[Belarus]] intensifies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/estonia-announces-snap-military-exercise-will-put-razor-wire-along-russian-2021-11-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**Seven people are killed and 10 others are injured after clashes between [[Azerbaijan]] and [[Armenia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-russia-moscow-sergei-shoigu-azerbaijan-b4bb5cc58f9435db7d5c287cee52de4d (AP)]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[November 2021 Pacific Northwest floods]]
**The [[Canadian government]] sends the [[Royal Canadian Air Force|Air Force]] to the Pacific coast to assist with supplies after torrential rains affected regions of [[British Columbia]] near [[Vancouver]], causing damage to highways. [[Minister of Emergency Preparedness]] [[Bill Blair (politician)|Bill Blair]] says that landslides and floods have blocked the town of [[Agassiz, British Columbia|Agassiz]] and residents are now being assisted by the military. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/17/canada-sends-air-force-to-help-reopen-supply-lines-after-floods (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[Royal Air Force]] [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 Lightning II]] jet crashes into the [[Mediterranean Sea]] during a routine operation. The pilot successfully ejects from the aircraft and has been rescued. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2021/nov/17/british-f35-jet-crashes-into-mediterranean (''The Guardian'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland]]
*****The [[Northern Ireland Executive]] votes to introduce a [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 vaccine passport]] beginning next month, which will contain a person's [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom|vaccination status]] or negative [[COVID-19 test]] result, and will be used to enter bars, restaurants and pubs. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-59325108 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports a record 14,416 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 996,320. [https://orf.at/stories/3236848/ (ORF)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 52,826 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/germany-sees-52826-virus-cases-seeks-earlier-boosters-81222776 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 1,247 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 259,084. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/russia-hits-new-all-time-high-coronavirus-death-toll/2423121 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Spain]]
****[[Spain]]’s panel of vaccine experts approves the extension of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] [[booster dose]] to people between the ages of 60 and 69 and [[healthcare worker]]s. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/spain-eyes-covid-19-boosters-for-health-workers-elderly/2021/11/17/b3c7d070-47cc-11ec-beca-3cc7103bd814_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] receives a shipment of 800,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.ambito.com/politica/vacunacion/coronavirus-llegan-hoy-al-pais-mas-800000-dosis-vacunas-sinopharm-n5318854 (Ámbito)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***The [[Food and Drug Administration (Philippines)|Food and Drug Administration of the Philippines]] authorises emergency use of the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine]], which will be included in the [[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines|national vaccination program]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1516237/novavax-covid-19-vaccine-gets-emergency-use-approval-in-ph  (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[White House COVID-19 Response Team| White House COVID-19 Response Coordinator]] [[Jeff Zients]] announces that 80% of people aged 12 and older have received their first doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/health/2021/11/17/covid-vaccine-mandate-challenge-mask/8643697002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.cbs17.com/community/health/coronavirus/white-house-80-of-americans-12-and-older-now-partially-vaccinated-but-nc-lags-behind/ (WNCN-TV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[United States|American]] [[rapper]] [[Young Dolph]] is shot and killed at a [[bakery]] in [[Memphis, Tennessee]], by an unidentified gunman. [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/nov/17/young-dolph-rapper-shot-killed (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Former [[President of Georgia]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]], who has been on a [[hunger strike]] for 48 days, is in critical condition. Yesterday, [[Ministry of Justice of Georgia|Justice Minister]] Rati Bregadze denied Saakashvili transfer to a civilian clinic, from a [[Prison healthcare|prison hospital]] where he is being treated. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211118-jailed-georgian-ex-president-saakashvili-in-critical-condition-after-weeks-on-hunger-strike (France 24)]
